liner.body_md:
## Setlist highlights

- **Bound To Ride**: rare: 12 archived performances [6]
- **Miss The Mississippi And You**: rare: 12 archived performances [6]
- **The Train That Carried My Girl From Town > Black Mountain Rag**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [6]
- Earliest performances in the archive: My Alice [6]

## The recordings

- **billystrings2022-09-23.InsideOut_AKG568_ck61_ck63** (recommended): source not stated; 27 songs; 169 min [1]
- **billystrings2022-09-23.InsideOut_AKG568**: source not stated; 27 songs; 169 min [2]
- **billystrings2022-09-23.InsideOut_AKG.ck63**: source not stated; 27 songs; 169 min [3]
- **billystrings2022-09-23.InsideOut_AKG.ck61.ck63**: source not stated; 27 songs; 169 min [4]

## Tapers and lineage

- **billystrings2022-09-23.InsideOut_AKG568_ck61_ck63**: taped by HealthCov Chris; transferred by InsideOut Recording; source: AKG 568 + AKG ck61 + AKG ck63 > SD MixPre-10ii [1]. Also: Three mic sources: AKG ck61 (NOS) and ck63 (PAS) via Nbob actives and Naiant pfa, plus AKG 568 via GaKables, all to SD MixPre-10ii; Mics hung nine feet high, right side of the SBD cage; pulled and processed by HealthCov Chris at InsideOut Recording [1]
- **billystrings2022-09-23.InsideOut_AKG568**: taped by HealthCov Chris; transferred by InsideOut Recording; source: AKG 568 (PAS) > SD MixPre-10ii [2]. Also: AKG 568 (PAS) went straight to an SD MixPre-10ii, mic placed nine feet high, right side of the SBD cage [2]
- **billystrings2022-09-23.InsideOut_AKG.ck63**: taped by HealthCov Chris; transferred by InsideOut Recording; source: AKG ck63 > Nbobs actives > Naiant pfa > SD MixPre-10ii [3]. Also: AKG ck63 (PAS) went directly to an SD MixPre-10ii, mic placed nine feet high, right side of the SBD cage [3]
- **billystrings2022-09-23.InsideOut_AKG.ck61.ck63**: taped by HealthCov Chris; transferred by InsideOut Recording; source: AKG ck61 + ck63 > Nbob actives > Naiant pfa > SD MixPre-10ii [4]. Also: Two mic sources: AKG ck61 (NOS) and ck63 (PAS), each through Nbob actives and Naiant pfa into an SD MixPre-10ii; Mics stood nine feet high, right side of the SBD cage; pulled and processed by HealthCov Chris at InsideOut Recording [4]

## Art and photos

- Poster by Brandon Wenerd: [Billy Strings Stream – Watch Live From The Renewal Festival via nugs.net](https://brobible.com/culture/article/billy-strings-stream-renewal-festival/) [7]
